caption: The drawing contains several stylized botanical designs on a beige background. On the left side, there is a large green vase with an arrangement of three curving branches, each adorned with clusters of green leaves and multiple red fruit-like shapes. On the upper right, there is a horizontal border design composed of green leaf-like forms and small green dots arranged symmetrically. Below the border, in the middle right section, there is a single large green tendril curving upwards, bearing several green leaves and red petal or fruit shapes. At the bottom right, there is a smaller motif consisting of a central red tulip-shaped flower with two small green leaves at its base and three larger green leaves fanning out around it, accompanied by smaller leaf and bud shapes. The primary colors used are shades of green and red, and all elements are formed with solid, flat areas of color without any shading or texture.
title: Stencil Wall Decoration
